card.statement:
Let $\ga$ be a basic classcial Lie superalgebra or $\qn$, and let $\chi \in \ev \ga^*$ be nilpotent. Let $d_i = \dim \ga_i - \dim
(\ga_{\chi})_i,\; i \in \Z_2$. Then the dimension of every $U_{\chi}(\ga)$-module $M$ is divisible by $p^{\frac{d_0}{2}}
2^{\lfloor \frac{d_1}{2}\rfloor}$, where $\lfloor
\frac{d_1}{2}\rfloor$ denotes the least integer which is $\geq
\frac{d_1}{2}$.
card.label: Theorem 67

paper.title: Nilpotent orbits and finite $W$-algebras
paper.abstract: In recent years, the finite W-algebras associated to a semisimple Lie algebra and its nilpotent element have been studied intensively from different viewpoints. In this lecture series, we shall present some basic constructions, connections, and applications of finite W-algebras.
